To determine the total number of checks Buford writes per year, we need to calculate the annual frequency for each type of check and sum them up.

**Step 1: Calculate the number of electric bill checks per year.**
Buford writes a check for the electric bill once per month.
There are 12 months in a year.
$$1 \text{ check/month} \times 12 \text{ months/year} = 12 \text{ checks/year}$$

**Step 2: Calculate the number of gas bill checks per year.**
Buford writes a check for the gas bill once per month.
There are 12 months in a year.
$$1 \text{ check/month} \times 12 \text{ months/year} = 12 \text{ checks/year}$$

**Step 3: Calculate the number of church checks per year.**
Buford writes a check to the church twice per month.
There are 12 months in a year.
$$2 \text{ checks/month} \times 12 \text{ months/year} = 24 \text{ checks/year}$$

**Step 4: Calculate the number of pest and lawn service checks per year.**
Buford writes a check to the pest and lawn service quarterly.
"Quarterly" means once every three months, or 4 times per year.
$$4 \text{ checks/year}$$

**Step 5: Sum the annual checks for all categories.**
Total checks = (Electric) + (Gas) + (Church) + (Pest/Lawn)
$$Total = 12 + 12 + 24 + 4$$

Calculation:
$$12 + 12 = 24$$
$$24 + 24 = 48$$
$$48 + 4 = 52$$

Buford writes a total of 52 checks per year.

Final answer: 52
